Table Mode — Visual HTML Table Editor

Edit HTML, CSV, and JSON tables visually in your browser. Drag-and-drop rows and columns, merge cells, transpose, apply CSS classes, and export clean HTML, Markdown, CSV, or SQL. No install.

What you can do

  • Drag-and-drop row and column reordering
  • Cell merging with auto-calculated colspan and rowspan
  • Transpose — flip rows and columns in one click
  • Apply CSS classes, IDs, and inline styles per cell, row, or column
  • Export to HTML, Markdown, CSV, JSON, and SQL
  • Full undo/redo history
